User is learning Spanish and has a weekly language-exchange class at a local language school with Colombian tutor Maria. They meet on Thursday evenings. Maria helps the user with Spanish pronunciation and grammar, while the user helps her with English vocabulary. User values practical conversational fluency help, including active listening, transitions, idiomatic phrasing, pronunciation, contextual practice, and discussion topics.

User is planning a trip to Colombia, particularly Bogotá, and wants travel tips and useful Spanish phrases. They plan to visit Museo del Oro (Gold Museum), then walk to nearby Plaza de Bolívar and explore La Candelaria. They are interested in the museum’s pre-Columbian collections and its treatment of the Spanish conquest, Indigenous cultures, resource exploitation, and cultural syncretism. At Plaza de Bolívar, they can see the cathedral, Congress/Capitolio, Palacio Liévano, and the Simón Bolívar monument, and may get a snack at a café. Other nearby interests include Chorro de Quevedo, Iglesia/Museo de San Francisco, Casa del Florero/Museo de la Independencia, Casa de la Moneda, Teatro Colón, colonial streets, street art, and local food. Safety precautions and crowd awareness matter; practical Spanish shopping phrases were requested.

User may have dinner plans with friends on other evenings.
